Yeah, now that I think about it, when we talk about Marisa stealing books from the library, Patchouli would only be upset only from a book reader's perspective (it's her book, after all). However, the one person who'd be really pissed off would be the librarian.

🤔 Now that I look back, I'd assumed Patchouli was a librarian with Koakuma being her assistant.
